Nursing Programs Krishna School of Nursing (KSN) Faculty of Nursing - KPGU, Vadodara WELCOME Message from the Director Prof. Nimesh Chokshi Director, KSN Krishna School of Nursing (KSN) is a constituent institute of KPGU, Vadodara - dedicated to producing skilled, compassionate nursing professionals who meet the standards of the Indian Nursing Council (INC). Our programs are designed to develop nurses who are not just clinically competent but genuinely prepared to lead and serve in modern healthcare environments. At KSN, students receive extensive clinical and practical training through advanced skill labs and simulation labs - built around competency-based learning that closely mirrors real hospital settings. Our curriculum prioritises critical thinking, evidence-based practice, patient-centered care, effective communication, and collaborative teamwork across healthcare disciplines. Every program at KSN is built with one goal: to prepare nurses who can deliver safe, high-quality care across diverse healthcare settings - from primary health centres to multispeciality hospitals - and play an active, confident role in promoting health and managing complex patient needs. Key Highlights Approved by the Indian Nursing Council (INC) - meeting national nursing education standards Competency-based, simulation-driven clinical training program structure Advanced skill labs and simulation labs for hands-on, real-world learning Evidence-based practice and clinical research integrated throughout the curriculum Programs structured in full alignment with INC national nursing regulations Strong emphasis on patient-centered, ethical, and compassionate nursing care VALUES & GOALS Vision & Mission Our Vision “To contribute to global healthcare through excellence in nursing education, research, and innovation - producing compassionate, competent nurses who uphold the highest standards of patient care.” Our Mission Build nurses with a strong scientific and clinical foundation for modern healthcare delivery Develop critical thinking, clinical reasoning, and practical problem-solving capabilities Cultivate leadership, communication, and professional responsibility in every graduate Foster global healthcare readiness and collaborative practice for improved patient outcomes ACADEMICS Programs & Duration Program Name Level Duration GNM - General Nursing & Midwifery (Diploma) Diploma 3 Years B.Sc.
